# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues, pull requests or discussions.**

Report them privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/boring-mars/mertina-agent/security/advisories/new).
Include a description, affected versions, steps to reproduce and the potential impact.

The maintainer will acknowledge your report within 3 working days and keep you informed about the fix.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.
